title: genista dorycnifolia f. grosii
intro: Genista dorycnifolia f. grosii, commonly known as the spiny broom, is a flowering plant species in the legume family. It is a shrub-like plant used in traditional medicine, valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Genista dorycnifolia f. grosii include wound healing, pain relief, and immune system modulation, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids. Further research is needed to fully understand the bioactive constituents and therapeutic actions of this plant, but it has shown promise in traditional medicine for various health applications.
